name: truck-packer-3d
description: A professional 3D truck packing visualization tool

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:html
scripts.test:ci:browser: node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/audit/auth-overlay-lifecycle.spec.mjs tests/audit/autopack-progress-status.spec.mjs tests/audit/modal-focus.spec.mjs tests/audit/recovery-overlay-lifecycle.spec.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="^(?:hidden packed cargo keeps one physical pose|Shortcut contract: viewport cargo keys|G6 two clicks save one measurement|G5 the overlay is SVG/DOM|P2-6 an unfinished Point A|P2-7 a real held case .gizmo stroke|P1-3 parity|P1-3 real pointer|PR-B scheduler skips signature work|EXPORT-A service boundary|EXPORT-A Screenshot uses only supported sizes|EXPORT-A PDF views: print background|EXPORT-A capture failure or a changed scene|EXPORT-A Workspace Backup dialog stays bound|Orthographic preview capture fits output aspect|EXPORT-M Screenshot, PDF and thumbnail authority|EXPORT-M a measurement edit never lets a stale scene|creating a callout|creating an arrow|the overlay is DOM above the canvas|Annotations and a saved measurement are on screen together|real AutoPack: clean while it runs or previews|N01: the panel yields to an open editor only while they share space|EXPORT-N Screenshot, PDF and thumbnail authority)" tests/audit/annotation-tool-interaction.spec.mjs tests/audit/autopack-editor-interaction.spec.mjs tests/audit/measurement-tool-interaction.spec.mjs tests/audit/preview-identity-context.spec.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="^Folder Stage 1" tests/behavioral/app-js-characterization.spec.mjs
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:ci:node && npm run test:regression:browser
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:ci:node && npm run test:ci:browser
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js -- --fix && npm run lint:css -- --fix
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.quality: npm run lint:fix && npm run format && echo '✅ Code quality checks passed!'
scripts.quality:ci: npm run lint && npm run -s typecheck && npm run test:ci && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev

author: 360 Virtual Tour Solutions
